acceptance_criteria.given: one accepted current piece saying covers: partial
acceptance_criteria.then: state in_progress, reason 'partial evidence only', accepted_count 1

acceptance_criteria.given: the same requirement with a second accepted piece saying full, or one accepted piece with no covers
a gate document whose task serves a partial-only requirement
acceptance_criteria.then: first 409 gate_unsatisfied naming the requirement and 'partial'; then 200
acceptance_criteria.when: the task is approved, then approved again after a full piece is accepted

design: Coverage.reason (API field reason) carries 'partial evidence only'; requirement_gate.REMEDY_PARTIAL_ONLY. No migration.

checked: Acceptance test committed xfail(strict) at cfab18b, passing after the build

problem: covers (vis-D5) was recorded and displayed but never weighed, so a requirement read verified though the only accepted current evidence said covers: partial, and a gate document approved work its own author said demonstrated only part of the requirement (sweep 2026-10-18, group B).

requirements.rationale: The order ranks how much the evidence can be trusted, worst news first, so a reworded or drifting requirement is never reported verified. `rejected` is distinct so a refused demonstration is not mistaken for work not yet evidenced. Evidence its own author says covers only part of a requirement does not verify it (F706); evidence that says full, or nothing about covers, counts as covering, so evidence recorded before covers existed verifies as before.
requirements.statement: Coverage SHALL take the first state that applies, in this order: `drifting` (an open drift candidate), `stale` (evidence only against an earlier digest), `evidence_awaiting_review`, `verified` (accepted current-digest evidence, unless every accepted current piece says covers: partial, which reads `in_progress` with reason 'partial evidence only'), `rejected` (all current-digest evidence rejected), `in_progress` (linked work started or completed without evidence), `not_started`, `unserved` (no linked work).

requirements.rationale: The gate follows coverage: partial-only is in_progress.
requirements.statement: A gate-rigor document SHALL refuse approval of a task serving a requirement whose accepted current evidence is partial only, with a remedy that names the partial evidence and asks for a piece with covers: full; contract SHALL report it and sketch SHALL stay silent, as for any in_progress requirement.

in_scope: the Spec coverage list showing the reason
non_goals: Weighing covers beyond partial-only versus any full or unstated piece

summary: A requirement whose accepted current evidence all says covers: partial reads in_progress with reason 'partial evidence only', not verified; a gate document refuses approval on it (F706).
title: Partial evidence does not verify
